zomato.name: Zomato
zomato.message: All Zomato services are running normally.

faqs.question: What is Zomato integration?
faqs.answer: Jomato connects to your Zomato account to provide features like Food Rescue. Your credentials stay on your device. No data is sent to any third-party server.

faqs.question: Is my Zomato account safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use the same session tokens that the official Zomato app uses. Your password is never stored. You can revoke access anytime by removing your account in the app.

faqs.question: Why do I need to log in with my phone number?
faqs.answer: Zomato uses OTP-based authentication. The OTP request goes to Zomato's servers, and you verify it. Jomato never sees or stores your OTP.

zomato_food_rescue.name: Food Rescue
zomato_food_rescue.description: Get instant alerts when cancelled orders become available near you.

faqs.question: What is Food Rescue?
faqs.answer: When someone cancels a food order on Zomato, it becomes available for pickup at a heavily discounted price. Food Rescue alerts you the moment one appears in your area.

faqs.question: Does it use my GPS location?
faqs.answer: No. It uses the delivery area saved in your Zomato account (your saved addresses), not your phone's GPS.

faqs.question: Why does it need battery optimization disabled?
faqs.answer: Food Rescue runs a background service to listen for new orders. Android may kill it to save battery. Disabling battery optimization keeps it running reliably.

faqs.question: Will it drain my battery?
faqs.answer: Minimal impact. The service uses an MQTT connection and sleeps in between events. Most users report negligible battery usage.

content.question: What data does this app collect?
content.answer: Nothing. This is a zero-telemetry fork. No analytics, no tracking, no install IDs. The app only communicates with Zomato's own servers for login and Food Rescue.

content.question: Is this app affiliated with Zomato?
content.answer: No. This is an independent, open-source project. It is not endorsed by or affiliated with Zomato or Eternal Ltd. Use at your own risk.

content.question: Does the app use my GPS location?
content.answer: No. Food Rescue uses the delivery area saved in your Zomato account (your saved addresses), not your phone's GPS.

content.question: Where does my data go?
content.answer: Nowhere except Zomato's own servers when you use Food Rescue. Your session tokens are stored only on your device in local storage. No data is sent to any third-party server.

content.question: Can I delete my data?
content.answer: Yes. Removing your account in the app deletes your session from the device. Uninstalling the app removes everything.
